issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare Course.ratings as an array of Int, but the solution uses [Double] for ratings. This creates a cross-artifact type mismatch and also leads to internal type inconsistencies in the solution (e.g., addRating(stars: Int) appends an Int into a [Double] array and getAverageRating sums Double values into an Int accumulator). Students comparing template/problem with the reference solution will be confused about the intended type for ratings and may encounter non-compilable code in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent type for Course.ratings across all artifacts. Prefer changing the solution to match the problem/template by using ratings: [Int] and update getAverageRating() to sum Int values and return Double(Double(sum)/Double(count)). Ensure addRating(stars: Int) appends Int values and all arithmetic uses appropriate conversions to Double when computing the average. Alternatively, if fractional ratings are intended, update the problem statement and template to require [Double] and change method signatures accordingly — but make the choice consistent across problem, template, and solution.
